note: Batch A — heads-up 100bb single-raised-pot, SB(BTN) opens 2.5bb, BB calls, flop & turn check/check, BB (OOP) first to act on the river. Because both streets check through, the river ranges equal the preflop ranges (nothing narrowed them), so the inputs are transparent and documentable. Ranges are STANDARD REFERENCE HU 100bb SRP ranges and can be replaced by the owner's own; the solver computes the river strategy from them.
